architectural_decisions.basis: The audited subsystem already has immutable contracts, deterministic orchestration, explicit knowledge adaptation, and stable fingerprints.
architectural_decisions.decision: Evolve the existing Reasoning Engine rather than replace it.

architectural_decisions.basis: Lifecycle, budgets, history, review state, and executive directives naturally surround current deterministic execution.
architectural_decisions.decision: Introduce ReasoningSession as an execution envelope.

architectural_decisions.basis: It is already the anti-corruption boundary between retrieval data and canonical evidence.
architectural_decisions.decision: Preserve KnowledgeEvidenceAdapter as the provenance ingress.

architectural_decisions.basis: Its architectural value is dependency-injected composition.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: Immutability preserves replayability, auditability, and fingerprint integrity.
constitutional_invariants.rule: Canonical reasoning inputs and outputs are immutable value objects.
constitutional_invariants.title: Immutable Canonical Contracts
constitutional_invariants.validation: Canonical contracts remain frozen dataclasses or enforce equivalent immutability.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: Reasoning must be reproducible and testable.
constitutional_invariants.rule: Equivalent canonical requests processed by the same engine version produce equivalent canonical results.
constitutional_invariants.title: Deterministic Core
constitutional_invariants.validation: Repeated executions produce identical canonical serialization and fingerprints.

constitutional_invariants.rule: Reasoning may assess only evidence explicitly present in ReasoningRequest.
constitutional_invariants.title: Explicit Evidence
constitutional_invariants.validation: Core reasoning modules perform no direct retrieval or network access.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: The adapter protects the reasoning core from retrieval schema drift.
constitutional_invariants.rule: External knowledge enters reasoning through KnowledgeEvidenceAdapter.
constitutional_invariants.title: Knowledge Boundary Isolation
constitutional_invariants.validation: Pipeline inputs to reasoning are canonical EvidenceItem objects.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: Thin orchestration preserves replaceability and testability.
constitutional_invariants.rule: KnowledgeReasoningPipeline coordinates dedicated components and does not absorb their responsibilities.
constitutional_invariants.title: Thin Composition Pipeline
constitutional_invariants.validation: Search, adaptation, generation, and reasoning remain delegated.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: Recommendations are advisory outputs, not executive authority.
constitutional_invariants.rule: Reasoning may recommend actions but does not create, authorize, or execute operational plans.
constitutional_invariants.title: Inference and Planning Separation
constitutional_invariants.validation: Core reasoning performs no mission or planning state mutation.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: Operators require transparent and reviewable reasoning.
constitutional_invariants.rule: Completed reasoning results expose an ordered trace of material reasoning stages.
constitutional_invariants.title: Auditable Trace
constitutional_invariants.validation: Trace ordering is stable and includes validation and conclusion selection.

constitutional_invariants.rationale: Stable identifiers enable replay and provenance.
constitutional_invariants.rule: Derived identifiers use stable canonical inputs.
constitutional_invariants.title: Stable Identifier Derivation
constitutional_invariants.validation: Identifiers do not depend on time, randomness, memory addresses, or unordered traversal.

constitutional_invariants.rule: Reasoning recommends; executive layers authorize; execution occurs elsewhere.
constitutional_invariants.title: No Hidden Executive Authority
constitutional_invariants.validation: Reasoning modules expose no mission execution side effects.

constitutional_invariants.rule: Compatibility-affecting contract, fingerprint, ranking, or result changes require explicit versioning and migration.
constitutional_invariants.title: Versioned Evolution
constitutional_invariants.validation: Architecture-impacting changes include regression fixtures and version updates.

executive_summary: The existing Reasoning Engine is a coherent deterministic subsystem. Genesis will evolve it through a ReasoningSession envelope, structured provenance, executive governance, adaptive reasoning, calibration, and governed learning while preserving canonical contracts and authority boundaries.
purpose: Define the canonical architecture, constitutional invariants, approved extension points, and controlled evolution path for the JARVIS Reasoning Engine.
